title: Tiny, cute camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='72' height='48' rx='12' fill='#4a5a7d'/>
  <!-- top shade -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='72' height='18' rx='10' fill='#6d80a8'/>
  <!-- viewfinder bump -->
  <rect x='36' y='22' width='28' height='14' rx='6' fill='#6d80a8'/>
  <rect x='42' y='26' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#8fa4cc'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='22' fill='#8fa4cc'/>
  <!-- lens mid ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='17' fill='#3b4664'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='12' fill='#5ad1e6'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='52' r='4' fill='#bff3fb'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#bff3fb'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='66' y='30' width='14' height='9' rx='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='22' y='27' width='12' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='10' height='8' rx='4' fill='#6d80a8'/>
  <rect x='62' y='78' width='10' height='8' rx='4' fill='#6d80a8'/>
  <!-- happy eyes on flash side... cute face on lens -->
</svg>
